name: Aroha Renata
bio: Aroha's journey into motorsport was unconventional, starting with a computer science degree and a passion for coding. She initially worked in corporate IT, but the thrill of optimizing racing simulations in her spare time drew her closer to the track. Landing a volunteer role analyzing telemetry data for a local racing team solidified her desire to fuse her technical skills with her love for speed. She joined FVee Brasil five years ago, revolutionizing their data infrastructure. Aroha's focus is on creating robust and reliable systems that give the team a competitive edge, emphasizing data security and efficient information flow. Her ability to translate complex technical jargon into actionable insights for the racing engineers is what sets her apart.

physical.hairStyle: Shoulder-length, slightly wavy, often pulled back in a practical ponytail.
physical.description: Aroha is of average height with a focused, observant gaze.

quirks: Always has a packet of licorice in her desk drawer.
Prefers to work late at night when the track is quiet.
Communicates primarily through diagrams and flowcharts.
